searchText: SSZ Engine Update: Prysm just implemented as per the latest spec commit (`d39e9a2`) in the working [PR](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/prysm/pull/16901). Also submitted a PR to build the docker image for this: https://github.com/ethpandaops/eth-client-docker-image-builder/pull/393. Would be glad if this could be included! <@412614104222531604> you don't need to run a PR for building, you can just use /build client-cl in discord 🙂 any channel on eth r&d discord works BN: `ethpandaops/prysm-beacon-chain:syjn99-prototype-ssz-over-http` VC: `ethpandaops/prysm-validator:syjn99-prototype-ssz-over-http`
